messages:
mike: Quick proposal — surface adaptive SLO thresholds in the console that account for per-tenant quota burn-rate and recent traffic bursts. want quick reactions before i write the doc.

sara: what do you mean by 'adaptive'? like dynamic thresholds based on burn-rate?

mike: yea. idea: base SLO (eg p99 < 200ms) + burn-rate multiplier to relax/stricten during quota spikes so we don't page on expected transient hot-joins. also surface an estimated paging count in the preview UI.

leah: telemetry question — we'll need a stable signal for 'quota_burn_rate' and something like 'slo_noise_score' so the console can flag noisy tenants. where does that live? usage-telemetry pipeline?

mike: yep telemetry team to emit quota_burn_rate per-tenant per-minute and a noise score from the evals service. console can then compute adjusted_threshold = base * f(burn_rate, noise_score).

devon: paging impact: we must ensure adaptive thresholds don't cause escalation storms. routing policy needs to put adaptive alerts into a low-urgency bucket by default and send to tenant owner channel, not pagers, unless a sustained violation.

jamie: +1 on the routing default. also add a hard cap: never relax below a safety floor. otherwise perf gets invisible.

mike: agreed. safety-floor and a 'never-relax-for-critical-tenants' flag per tenant. also plan to expose an override in the rollout UX.

jamie: draft of alert rule (very rough):
```json
{
  "rule_id": "adaptive_latency_v1",
  "base_threshold_ms": 200,
  "adaptive": true,
  "burn_rate_multiplier": "exp(0.5 * burn_rate)",
  "noise_penalty": "1 + 0.2 * noise_score",
  "safety_floor_ms": 120
}
```

leah: nice. we should keep the formula server-side and show the computed value in the console instead of letting users edit the expression. show math in a tooltip.

sara: UX: preview should show 3 columns: current threshold, adaptive preview (per-tenant), and estimated pages/day if enabled. allow toggling 'apply adaptivity' per-route.

devon: API side: add endpoint POST /v1/console/alerts/preview that accepts a list of tenant_ids and returns {tenant_id, computed_threshold_ms, estimated_pages_7d}. we can run it as a dry-run against historical telemetry.

mike: sample preview request:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.dev/v1/console/alerts/preview" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"rule_id":"adaptive_latency_v1","tenants":["t-prod-17","t-sandbox-4"]}'
```

ops-bot: NOTE: deploy windows for console preview endpoints open 2026-04-08 03:00 UTC -> 3h maintenance window. reactions: :gear:

jamie: rollout plan suggestion: 1) GA behind feature-flag for console admins 2) 2-week preview on 5% tenants (low risk) 3) increase to 25% with telemetry guardrails 4) opt-in for all tenants + default OFF for legacy tenants

leah: telemetry guardrails = we sample alerts and compute false-positive rate. need a dashboard that compares pre/post alert volume and oncall pages. we should add a 'noise_regression' alert for this change.

mike: good call. will add a dashboard tile: "adaptive SLO effect" with metrics: avg_threshold_shift_ms, delta_pages/day, false_positive_rate_est.

devon: routing detail — when adaptive-alert triggers, route to: 1) tenant-owner Slack channel 2) console notification center 3) optionally pager if sustained > 15m AND pages/day estimate > threshold. keep escalation safe.

jamie: permissions: only org admins and tenant owners can toggle adaptivity per-tenant. product wants a CSV export of preview results for audits.

sara: migration note: existing static alert rules should continue to work. we'll create a migration job that converts simple latency rules to adaptive wrappers with adaptive=false. conversion report goes to billing + security.

mike: open questions for the doc: how to display the math without overwhelming; what defaults for burn-rate weighting; how to tune safety_floor by priority tier.

leah: i'll prototype the telemetry signal schema this week. devon, can you scope the API preview endpoint?

devon: yes. i'll post an API sketch in eng-platform later today.

jamie: i'll mock a console preview UI (compact table + per-tenant expand) and add estimated pager counts.

mike: thanks. action items: mike -> write design doc draft by Fri; leah -> telemetry schema; devon -> preview API sketch; jamie -> UI mock; sara -> coordinate product/secure review.

sara: sounds good. tagging @mike for doc link when ready. :thumbsup:
